scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p electron && node scripts/ensure-electron-cjs.mjs && electron dist-electron/main.js
scripts.package: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && pwsh backend/build_and_package.ps1 -SkipFrontendBuild && electron-builder

scripts.package:got: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && pwsh backend/build_and_package.ps1 -SkipFrontendBuild --SkipModelBundle && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.got.yml
scripts.package:paddle: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && pwsh backend/build_and_package.ps1 -SkipFrontendBuild --SkipModelBundle && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.paddle.yml
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron && pwsh backend/build_and_package.ps1 -SkipFrontendBuild && electron-builder --mac
